storyReader.landing.description: StoryReader routes validate a story address, so the region, story type, and story ID stay in the URL. Pick how this story should be presented.
storyReader.landing.title: Story Reader
storyReader.modes.live2dPlayer.descripti: Reserve the full reader stage for scenario playback. Live2D rendering, audio, and subtitles arrive with the player adapter work.
storyReader.modes.live2dPlayer.title: Live2D Player
storyReader.modes.sampleNote: Both actions open the sample unit story route. Routes show stubbed metadata only — no story data is fetched yet.
storyReader.modes.textOnly.description: Reserve a plain-text reading frame for the scenario. Text-Only keeps the focus on the story content, without the Live2D stage.
storyReader.modes.textOnly.title: Text-Only
storyReader.player.description: This Live2D Player route validates the story address and reserves the reader stage for scenario playback. No story data is fetched yet.
storyReader.player.loading.label: Reader stage reserved
storyReader.player.status.description: Scenario fetching, Live2D rendering, and audio playback arrive with the player adapter work. This page keeps a stable stage so the reader can slot in without layout shifts.
storyReader.player.status.title: Player adapter not wired up yet
storyReader.player.switchToTextOnly: Prefer plain text? Open this story in the Text-Only reader
storyReader.player.title: Live2D Player
storyReader.textOnly.description: This Text-Only route validates the story address and reserves a plain-text reading frame. No scenario text is fetched yet, and the Live2D stage is not part of this mode.
storyReader.textOnly.loading.label: Text reading frame reserved
storyReader.textOnly.status.description: Scenario text fetching arrives with the text reader work. This page keeps a stable reading frame so content can slot in without layout shifts.
storyReader.textOnly.status.title: Text reader not wired up yet
storyReader.textOnly.switchToPlayer: Want the full stage? Open this story in the Live2D Player
storyReader.textOnly.title: Text-Only Reader
